Projects

HIS Medical System

Description: The project skeleton is built on the Spring Cloud Alibaba ecosystem, integrating Spring AI and Spring AI Alibaba for intelligent application capabilities. MySQL is used for persistent data management, with the frontend built on the Vue 3 ecosystem and the Element Plus UI framework. Additionally, a C++ microservice development solution is provided.

Tech Stack: React, MongoDB, MySQL, Spring Boot, MyBatis-Plus
